title: Alexander Colón, Wichita Area Real Estate Agent
description: Straight answers about buying and selling in Wichita, Maize, Derby, Andover, Goddard, Park City, and Rose Hill. Ask a question before you commit to anything.
h1: Relationships first. Real answers from a real guy.

portrait.needed: Supplied. Kept here as the record of what was asked for: a background-removed portrait PNG at 2x, with its pixel width and height recorded so the frame reserves the right box and nothing shifts.

Measured on arrival rather than assumed: the alpha channel is real (54.7 percent of pixels fully transparent, 0.97 percent partial), the subject's bounding box is x 15 to 1999 by y 250 to 1999, and the matte carries no light halo (edge pixels average 4.9 luminance units darker than the opaque pixel beside them, not brighter).

bands.heading: What people say about working with Alex
What happens if you contact him

items.q: Does contacting Alex sign me up for anything?
items.a: No. A question is a question. There is no sequence behind these forms, and asking one thing does not put you on a list that mails you every week.

items.q: Will he push me to buy or sell before I am ready?
items.a: No. He works with people months out from doing anything, and a fair number of those conversations end with him saying the timing is wrong. That is a normal outcome, not a failed one.

items.q: How do I reach him, and which does he prefer?
items.a: Call or text (813) 613-8822, or email alex@athomewichita.com. Text is usually the fastest way to get him, and he is fine handling an entire question that way if you never want to be on the phone.

items.q: What does it cost to talk to him?
items.a: Nothing. Agent commission is paid out of the transaction and it is spelled out in writing before you sign anything, so there is no bill attached to asking questions.
